scenario.title: 英文面試：介紹經歷與成就
scenario.context: 英文面試最常卡在「講自己的成就」：台灣人習慣說「我負責…」「我參與了…」，聽起來很被動。英文面試要用強動詞（led、launched、increased）和具體數字，並用對時態區分過去的經歷和現在的能力。

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: So, tell me a bit about yourself.
lines.zh: 請簡單介紹一下你自己。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sure. I'm a brand designer with six years of experience, mostly in food and beverage.
lines.zh: 好的。我是品牌設計師，有六年經驗，主要在餐飲領域。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: At my last agency, I led the rebrand of a tea chain with over 40 stores. After the launch, their social media following grew by 60 percent.
lines.zh: 在上一間公司，我主導了一個超過 40 家店的茶飲品牌重塑，上線後他們的社群追蹤數成長了 60%。

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Impressive. And what have you been doing since then?
lines.zh: 很厲害。那之後你在做什麼？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I've been freelancing for about a year. I've worked with twelve clients so far, so I've had to wear many hats: designer, project manager, and salesperson.
lines.zh: 我接案大概一年了，到目前為止合作過十二個客戶，所以我得身兼多職：設計師、專案經理、業務。

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.en: Why do you want to join an in-house team now?
lines.zh: 為什麼現在想加入內部團隊？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I miss collaborating every day. I'm a people person, and I do my best work with a team.
lines.zh: 我很懷念每天跟人合作。我很擅長跟人相處，在團隊中我的表現最好。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I think well. You were right. I had to sell myself more than I'm used to.
lines.zh: 應該不錯。你說得對，我得比平常更推銷自己。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Did you mention the tea rebrand numbers?
lines.zh: 你有提到茶飲品牌重塑的數字嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yes. Instead of saying I was responsible for it, I said I led it. It felt weird, but they seemed impressed.
lines.zh: 有。我沒有說我負責那個案子，而是說我主導了它。感覺很怪，但他們看起來很佩服。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Good. They want someone who can hit the ground running.
lines.zh: 很好。他們要的是能馬上上手的人。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Fingers crossed. They said they'd let me know by Friday.
lines.zh: 祈禱吧。他們說週五前會通知我。

patterns.en: I have ___ years of experience in ___.
patterns.zh: 我在 ___ 領域有 ___ 年經驗。
我帶領一個 ___ 人的團隊。

patterns.en: One thing I'm working on is ___.
patterns.note: 回答「你的缺點」時很好用

patterns.en: I'm looking for a role where I can ___.
patterns.zh: 我在找一個能讓我 ___ 的職位。

patterns.en: What does a typical day look like?
patterns.zh: 這個職位的一天大概是怎樣？

chinglish.wrong: I was responsible for the rebrand project.
chinglish.right: I led the rebrand. / I managed the rebrand from start to finish.
chinglish.why: be responsible for 是職務描述，聽起來像只在名單上。強動詞（led、designed、launched）才能展現你實際做了什麼。

chinglish.wrong: I have participated in many projects.
chinglish.right: I've worked on over twenty projects, including ___.
chinglish.why: participate 很模糊。用具體數字和例子。

chinglish.wrong: My English is not good, please forgive me.
chinglish.why: 面試開頭先為英文道歉會讓對方把焦點放在你的弱點上。

chinglish.wrong: I am a hard-working person and I can eat bitter.
chinglish.right: I'm resilient. I work well under pressure.
chinglish.why: 「吃苦耐勞」直翻 eat bitter 不是英文。

grammar.title: 描述成就：強動詞＋時態
grammar.oneLiner: 講成就用「強動詞 + 具體結果 + 數字」；過去的工作用過去式，到現在的累積用現在完成式。
whenToUse: 過去的職位和成就用過去式：I led / launched / redesigned / increased…
到現在的經驗累積用現在完成式：I've worked with twelve clients so far.
持續中的工作用現在完成進行式：I've been freelancing for a year.
強動詞清單：led, launched, built, designed, grew, cut, increased, reduced, negotiated, streamlined。
結構：動詞 + 做了什麼 + 結果（數字）。I redesigned the menu, which increased average orders by 15%.
避免弱動詞：was responsible for, participated in, helped with, was involved in。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文職場習慣低調，履歷和面試常寫「負責」「參與」「協助」。直翻成英文會讓面試官覺得你只是跑腿的。英文面試文化期待你清楚說出自己的貢獻，這不是自大，而是讓對方能判斷你的能力。另外，時態也很關鍵：用錯了會讓人誤會你還在前一份工作。

examples.correct: I launched a new product line that brought in 2 million NT dollars.
examples.incorrect: I was involved in a new product line.

examples.correct: I've managed over thirty client projects.
examples.note: 到現在為止的累積，用現在完成式。

examples.correct: I've been leading the design team since 2024.
I cut production time by 30% by creating a template system.
At my last job, I trained five junior designers.
examples.incorrect: At my last job, I have trained five junior designers.
examples.note: 已經離職的工作用過去式。

quiz.question: Which sounds strongest in an interview?
options: I was responsible for the website.
I redesigned the website, which doubled sign-ups.

quiz.question: At my previous company, I ___ a team of four.
quiz.explanation: 已經離開的工作用過去式。

quiz.question: I've ___ (work) with over fifty clients so far.
quiz.explanation: so far 用現在完成式。

quiz.question: I ___ as a freelancer since last year.
quiz.explanation: since + 持續到現在，用完成進行式。

quiz.question: I reduced costs by 20% ___ switching suppliers.

slang.meaning: 一上任就馬上進入狀況
slang.usage: 不需要太多適應期，立刻開始有產出。職缺描述很常見。

examples.en: We need someone who can hit the ground running.
examples.zh: 我們需要能馬上上手的人。

examples.en: Thanks to the training, I hit the ground running on day one.
examples.zh: 多虧了訓練，我第一天就進入狀況。

slang.usage: 在面試或提案時展現自己的價值。

examples.en: You need to sell yourself more in interviews.
examples.zh: 你面試時要多推銷自己。

examples.en: I'm bad at selling myself, but I'm working on it.
examples.zh: 我不太會推銷自己，但我在練習。

slang.usage: 喜歡和人互動、善於溝通的人。I'm a people person.

risk.note: 面試常用，但太常被用，最好搭配具體例子。

examples.en: She's a real people person. Clients love her.
examples.zh: 她很會跟人相處，客戶都很喜歡她。

examples.en: I'm not much of a people person. I prefer working alone.
examples.zh: 我不太擅長跟人打交道，比較喜歡一個人做事。

slang.usage: 在小公司或自由接案時一人扮演多種角色。

risk.note: 面試和履歷常用，帶正面意涵。

examples.en: At a startup, everyone wears many hats.
examples.zh: 在新創公司，每個人都身兼多職。

examples.en: As a freelancer, I wear many hats: designer, accountant, and marketer.
examples.zh: 接案者要身兼多職：設計、會計、行銷。

review.question: By the time I left the agency, I ___ there for five years.
review.explanation: 複習第 50 單元：過去完成式。

review.question: I ___ have prepared more examples. (後悔)
review.explanation: 複習第 49 單元：should have + p.p.。

review.question: ___ the interview, I felt confident.
review.explanation: 複習第 47 單元：having + p.p. 表先完成。

review.question: The interviewer ___ to like my portfolio.
review.explanation: 複習第 43 單元：seem to V。

review.question: You had three interviews today? You ___ be exhausted.
review.explanation: 複習第 35 單元：must 推測。

review.question: ___ impressive portfolio!
review.explanation: 複習第 19 單元：What an + 形容詞 + 名詞。

review.question: At a small company, you have to wear many ___.
review.explanation: wear many hats = 身兼多職。
